title: Surgical complication screening prompts

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports recovery observation, pain or nausea assessment, discharge criteria, instructions, escort, complications, handover, and follow-up only as clinician-completed documentation.
user_facing_items.population: Patients receiving planned day surgery or procedure services in DoH-licensed facilities, with age, risk, procedure, anesthesia, and discharge qualifications.
user_facing_items.setting: DoH-licensed day surgery and procedure facilities in Abu Dhabi.
restrictions: UAE-direct for service governance, assessment, care plans, pre/intra/post-procedure documentation, records, discharge, and patient education. It does not replace anesthesiologist judgment, facility policy, consent, credentialing, or emergency care.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports review of suspected infection, cellulitis, microbiology context, structured wound care, and local heat, redness, pain, swelling, discharge, separation, abscess, fever, or systemic signs.
user_facing_items.population: Adults, young people, and children having a surgical procedure involving a skin incision.
user_facing_items.setting: Perioperative, postoperative, community, and specialist wound-care services.
restrictions: Exact for postoperative wound-care and surgical-site-infection documentation; partial for traumatic wounds, suture removal, and UAE pathways.
user_facing_items.rationale: Supports review of wound infection signs and systemic features for surgical complication screening prompts; no decision is generated.
